responsibilities.description: Applies a business pricing rule: orders with more than 3 lines get a 10% discount on the subtotal, and the payable amount is the subtotal minus that discount. This domain rule sits in a notification service.
responsibilities.name: Compute volume discount and payable amount

responsibilities.description: Coordinates sending an 'Order confirmed' message to the customer's email through the injected Mailer port. The message includes the order id and the payable amount.
responsibilities.name: Send order confirmation to customer
